content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can set up a fully operational online store tailored to your needs as a digital creator in Africa. With tools like GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing, you can establish a digital storefront without relying on traditional financial platforms. The best part? This can all be done in under 48 hours. The infrastructure is ready, and you have the power to own your online sales experience.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The Sovereign Starter Stack is the minimum viable solution you need to get started. For $97, you receive a complete deployment of GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, allowing you to load up to three products and start selling immediately. With automatic crypto payment processing, you can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies while maintaining full ownership of your data. This stack gives you the essential tools to operate independently and efficiently, without the complications of payment gateways that restrict your access.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on the critical components necessary for your immediate success. Avoid getting bogged down by complex marketing strategies or advanced site features at this stage. Concentrate on setting up your infrastructure: host your site with GitHub Pages, implement Google Apps Script for order management, and integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. The goal is to establish a functioning online store that allows for quick transactions and reliable delivery. Everything else can wait until you're operational.
Take control of your digital sales—no more reliance on restricted platforms.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To initiate your first transaction, start by listing a product on your GitHub Pages store. Ensure that you have set up your NOWPayments account correctly to accept crypto payments. The USDT on Tron network is ideal, settling transactions in under 60 seconds for a cost under $0.10. Promote your store within your network and use social media channels to drive traffic. Once the payment is made, you will receive immediate confirmation via the NOWPayments webhook, ensuring a smooth transaction process.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, focus on the following actions: finalize your product listings, test your payment integration with NOWPayments, and ensure that your file delivery method is streamlined using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Start promoting your store to your audience and gather initial feedback. Consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit for $197, which includes all six blueprints and seven templates you need to build, deploy, and scale your digital commerce stack efficiently.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Blockchain payments open doors to international sales for African creators.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Global access to digital product revenue is not contingent on where you are located — it is contingent on which infrastructure you build on. The sovereign stack works identically from Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, Karachi, Dhaka, Harare, or Manila. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours under your accounts, tested on mainnet before handoff. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete build for self-deployers. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Creators in Africa can utilize blockchain-based payment systems like NOWPayments for international transactions, combined with a hosting solution like GitHub Pages to reach global customers. This infrastructure allows for seamless sales without depending on conventional payment gateways.
What payment methods work in Nigeria for online digital product sales?

In Nigeria, you can use NOWPayments to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, facilitating international sales without KYC requirements. Binance P2P also supports local currency transactions, enhancing your payment options.
Is there a way to sell ebooks from Pakistan without a Stripe account?

Yes, by using NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, creators in Pakistan can sell ebooks globally without needing a Stripe account. This allows you to access a wider audience and streamline your payment processes.
What are the costs associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee for transactions, making it a cost-effective solution for accepting payments. Additionally, using networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON ensures low transaction fees, often under $0.10.
